caption: Create a resource, search for Azure OpenAI, and select it — this is a standard Azure resource like any other.
Subscription, resource group, region, a resource name, and a pricing tier — Standard S0 is the only tier available today.
Once the deployment finishes, "Go to resource" takes you to the new Azure OpenAI resource — ready to deploy a model into.

eyebrow: The gotcha that trips everyone up once
code:
# OpenAI's API: pass the model name
client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o")

# Azure OpenAI: pass YOUR deployment name
client.chat.completions.create(
    model="my-support-bot-prod"
)
caption: Azure always routes by deployment name. Model name only picks what you deployed — it isn't what you call at request time.
